    • delete

      public Boolean delete(String projectId, String accessPolicyId, String lastRev)
      Description copied from interface: IAMAccessPolicies
      Deletes an access policy.

      The spec requires the policy's last-known revision in the request body for optimistic-concurrency-controlled deletion.

      Specified by:
      delete in interface IAMAccessPolicies
      Parameters:
      projectId - the project identifier
      accessPolicyId - the access policy identifier
      lastRev - the last-known revision of the policy (required; from AccessPolicy.getRev())
      Returns:
      true if the deletion request was accepted
